clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Krusk seeks help after Syndicate bandits capture the orc scouts sent into Durnholde Keep. Thrall had sent the party to investigate the growing threat and retrieve an object from the keep.

Warchief Thrall sent a band of orc warriors to the Hillsbrad Foothills to investigate the growing Syndicate threat and retrieve an object from Durnholde Keep. Gol'dir led the scouts toward the fortress ruins, where the Syndicate's numbers overwhelmed them in an ambush. Krusk broke free and limped back across the river to Tarren Mill. Drull, Tog'thar, and Gol'dir were captured by the human bandits.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Me and some other warriors were sent by the Warchief to retrieve an object from Durnholde and to investigate this so-called Syndicate.

We went to Durnholde to take a look around, but we were taken by surprise by a large number of the humans. We fought bravely, but their sheer numbers were enough to defeat us. They took a few of us captive, but I was able to escape.
Durnholde is just southeast of here, across the river. Drull and Tog'thar are being held there, you must go and rescue them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You must make haste, adventurer. I shudder to think what the humans might be doing to Drull and Tog'thar.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So the humans thought to turn our warriors into slaves, did they? We'll show them!
It would seem that they have taken Gol'dir, our leader, to another location. We must find him and rescue him. But we currently have no clue where he is...
When we have a lead, I will be sure to tell you, friend.
